How it works

Three steps. Fully automated.
No staff required.

1

Enquiry arrives

A patient contacts your practice via your website form, missed call, email, Facebook, Instagram, or Google Business Profile. Flowstate captures it instantly — even at 11pm on a Sunday.

2

AI qualifies the lead

Every enquiry is scored 0–10. The system detects urgency, extracts contact details, identifies treatment interest, and flags high-value patients — all before a human sees it.

3

Personalised reply sent

A tailored SMS or email goes out within 2 minutes — using your practice name and tone. If there's no reply, follow-ups run automatically. Patient questions are forwarded to your practice manager instantly.

FAQ

Common questions.

Most practices are live within 48–72 hours. We handle all the technical setup — you just provide access to your existing channels (website form, email, social) and we take it from there. There's no software to install and nothing for your staff to learn.
No. The system runs entirely in the background. Your staff will notice fewer missed leads and more pre-qualified enquiries — but their day-to-day workflow doesn't change. Patient questions that need a human response are forwarded directly to your practice manager's mobile.
The system handles initial contact and follow-up. If a patient asks a clinical question or something that requires a human response, the message is flagged and forwarded to your practice manager instantly. You stay in control of anything that matters.
No. You can cancel with 30 days notice at any time. We're confident the system will prove its value — you'll see that in your weekly report within the first month.
Yes. Flowstate works alongside your existing software — it handles enquiry capture and follow-up, and your team handles bookings through whatever system you already use. Booking automation is available as an optional add-on if you want to go fully hands-off.
All data is stored securely in Australia. We do not sell or share patient data with any third parties. The system handles contact information only — no clinical records are processed. Full data handling details are covered in the service agreement before onboarding.
